documented_observation: WeatherKit scope, forecast horizon, regional limits, attribution.

title: WeatherKit API inventory
documented_observation: Public datasets and request types inspected.
limit: Symbol inventory is not field availability for a destination.

title: HourWeather
documented_observation: Hourly temperature, precipitation, cloud, wind, UV and visibility.
limit: Hourly values do not resolve precise street or minute conditions.

title: precipitationChance
documented_observation: Hourly probability encoded from 0 to 1.
limit: Probability does not specify rainfall duration.

title: precipitationAmount
documented_observation: Hourly precipitation amount in liquid equivalent.
limit: Does not identify flooding or road surface condition.

title: MinuteWeather
documented_observation: Minute precipitation chance, type and intensity.
limit: Availability depends on location and provider.

title: apparentTemperature
documented_observation: Hourly feels-like temperature.
limit: Not a personalized heat exposure or medical threshold.

title: UVIndex
documented_observation: Value and exposure category.
limit: UV is a different dimension from temperature.

title: Ultraviolet radiation
documented_observation: UV protection from index 3; cloud cover does not remove UV exposure.
limit: General guidance, not personalized clinical advice.

title: Wind
documented_observation: Sustained speed, direction and optional gust.
limit: Does not describe structural shelter or transport operation.

title: visibility
documented_observation: Visibility distance influenced by light and atmospheric conditions.
limit: Not a confirmation that an attraction is visible or open.

title: SunEvents
documented_observation: Sunrise, sunset, twilight and solar events.
limit: No direct golden-hour range or building occlusion property.

title: CloudCoverByAltitude
documented_observation: Low, medium and high cloud fractions; iOS 18+.
limit: Cloud fractions are not a photographic quality score.

title: HourWeather.cloudCoverByAltitude
documented_observation: Property availability begins on iOS 18.
limit: Documented availability, no SDK compile test performed.

title: DayWeather
documented_observation: Day summaries, sun and moon, wind and precipitation details.
limit: Daily extrema do not identify conditions during a specific visit.

title: DayPartForecast
documented_observation: Weather for a part of the day; iOS 18+.
limit: Coarse period summary, not a replacement for hourly visit matching.

title: WeatherAlert
documented_observation: Agency source, summary, region, severity and details link.
limit: Alert availability and localization vary; not every alert is severe.

title: WeatherAvailability
documented_observation: Separate minute and alert availability flags.
limit: An absent alert does not mean conditions are safe.

title: AvailabilityKind
documented_observation: Available, unsupported, temporarily unavailable and unknown states.
limit: Check actual destination at runtime.

title: Weather app regional availability
documented_observation: Japan listed for minute precipitation and severe weather; Indonesia not listed.
limit: Weather app support matrix is a planning signal, not proof of WeatherKit API availability.

title: WeatherChanges
documented_observation: Qualitative changes from prior conditions; iOS 18+.
limit: Not a forecast-revision webhook or a push subscription.

title: WeatherChange
documented_observation: Temperature and day/night precipitation directions.
limit: Not a per-stop routing recommendation.

title: HistoricalComparisons
documented_observation: Current weather compared with historical baselines; iOS 18+.
limit: Not a future-date forecast.

title: monthlyStatistics(for:including:)
documented_observation: Long-term statistics for the twelve Gregorian months; iOS 18+.
limit: Monthly climatic context does not predict an exact date.

title: MonthPrecipitationStatistics
documented_observation: Monthly average precipitation amount, probability and snowfall.
limit: Average does not establish conditions on a particular trip.

title: MonthTemperatureStatistics
documented_observation: Monthly mean high and low temperatures.
limit: Not a temperature prediction for a chosen future date.

title: dailySummary(for:forDaysIn:including:)
documented_observation: Historical daily summaries for an interval; iOS 18+.
limit: Daily regional weather does not prove rain at a photo's time and place.

title: DailyWeatherSummaryQuery
documented_observation: Temperature and precipitation summary queries.
limit: The overview code example differs from the current declaration; use declaration when implementing.

title: DayPrecipitationSummary
documented_observation: Daily liquid precipitation and snowfall summaries.
limit: Not a historical cloud, UV or minute-rain archive.

title: MoonEvents
documented_observation: Moonrise, moonset and phase.
limit: Does not provide tides, aurora or light pollution.

title: WeatherMetadata
documented_observation: Request date, requested location and expiration date.
limit: Request time is not observation time or forecast valid time.
